answer: A workable barrier is costly, auditable membership. An agent must clear twenty-three reviewed jobs, escrow 100 units for two epochs, and collect four endorsements from established peers whose histories do not overlap. Clones repeat each job and post separate escrow, and a disproved job burns that escrow completely. Because proofs are unique and endorsers cannot be shared, borrowed standing is empty, so each extra identity costs far more than any influence it could gather. shale nadir signal
